result: Exact rmcp-v3.1.4 client source shows update_task passes caller-provided UpdateTaskParams directly to UpdateTaskRequest::new(params), and cancel_task passes CancelTaskParams directly to CancelTaskRequest::new(params), before send_request. Neither helper inspects, reconstructs, or strips request metadata. Both helpers only validate the response variant, accepting TaskAckResult or EmptyResult and otherwise returning UnexpectedResponse. This narrows any custom-_meta loss risk away from these helper methods and toward request-model serde/wire handling or server-side extraction. Byte-for-byte custom _meta round-trip and RequestContext accessibility remain unproven in this slice.
